segments.name: Neuroplastogenic Therapeutics
segments.description: Develops novel small-molecule neuroplastogenic therapeutics for psychiatric and neurological disorders including depression, anxiety, and addiction.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment with a focus on developing novel neuroplastogenic small-molecule therapeutics for the treatment of depression, anxiety, and addiction disorders.

changes.text: In 2025, the company announced it was soliciting requests for proposals to license or sell its PsyAI trademark portfolio.
changes.evidence: On March 6, 2025, we announced that we were soliciting Requests-For Proposals ("RFPs") for the license or sale of its PsyAI™ trademark portfolio as a means of maximizing value for an asset which is no longer strategic given our focus on drug development.
